name: Release Registry
scope: Versioned Ultra Brain release identities and their governed artifact locations.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.1 Foundation
entities.scope: Governance, architecture, registry, validation, release, and workspace-protection foundation; no operational Meta OS or UI implementation.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.2 Safety
entities.scope: Safety Core Meta OS validation, integrity, monitoring, risk, logging, audit, backup, recovery, execution-safety, and incident-management baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.3 Enhancement
entities.scope: Enhancement Core Meta OS analytics, bounded learning, patterns, knowledge candidates, optimization, draft rules, prediction, insight, and advisory decision-support baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.4 Automation
entities.scope: Automation Core Meta OS controlled workflows, triggers, scheduling, routines, registered local execution, typed decisions, pipelines, bounded batches, and local notification baseline.

entities.name: Ultra Brain v0.5 Collaboration & Connectivity
entities.scope: Collaboration & Connectivity Core Meta OS governed connector, credential-reference, data portability, synchronization, external-AI, repository, communication, and ecosystem exchange baseline.
